name: offline-translation-middleware
description: Monorepo for @offline-translator/middleware, its framework adapters and its optional local engine.

scripts.example: npm run build --workspace @offline-translator/middleware && npm run start --workspace @offline-translator/example-express
scripts.demo: npm run build --workspace @offline-translator/middleware && npm run demo --workspace @offline-translator/example-express
scripts.example:fastify: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run start --workspace @offline-translator/example-fastify
scripts.example:nestjs: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run start --workspace @offline-translator/example-nestjs
scripts.demo:fastify: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run demo --workspace @offline-translator/example-fastify
scripts.demo:nestjs: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run demo --workspace @offline-translator/example-nestjs
